title: sopubia filiformis
intro: Sopubia filiformis, commonly known as the 'thorny cordia', is a plant species belonging to the bignonia family. It is traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, including treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
